structured_output.summary: The package question ("Under what circumstances can a Citizen claim Carers Allowance?") cannot be answered completely from this package: its declared evidence status is insufficient, and requirement staff-038 records five absent obligations (evidence closure, applicability, legal version reconciliation, independent meaning review, question-scope resolution) that more retrieval cannot satisfy. The package is also truncated: budget.truncated is true (47 nodes, 49 relationships, reached depth 5 of 6), fourteen whole items were dropped for the byte budget (including DMG chapter 84, pages 84/0002, 84/0008, 84/0128, 85/0077, the beneficial-ownership term and several State Pension Credit legal provisions), and retrieval is truncated to sixteen highest-ranked lexical candidates out of 7,823, so other matching pages are outside scope. Within that frozen scope the selected exact DMG/ADM source pages do state a captured set of Carer's Allowance entitlement conditions (caring for a severely disabled person, regular and substantial care, not gainfully employed, aged 16 or over, not in full-time education, prescribed residence/presence conditions in Great Britain), plus captured rules on competing carers, caring for two or more disabled people, temporary breaks in care, an EU-coordination cohort affected by the AH judgment from 21 April 2023, and a pre-28.10.02 transitional protection for carers aged 65 and over. Several cross-referenced elements (gainful-employment earnings rules, the age condition detail, full-time education, the residence/presence conditions in DMG Chapter 07 Part 2) are referenced but not included; the definition of "severely disabled person" is cut off at a page boundary. The question terms "circumstances", "citizen" and "claim" are recorded as unresolved, so nationality, residence status and date are not established. Source text is captured, machine-extracted and marked unreviewed; capture dates are not publication, commencement or applicability dates. Nothing here is current-law assurance, a complete legal answer or an individual decision, and no award is calculated. Independent specialist human review is required.
